content.text:
**Finding: missing (medium severity) — transition assistance and data return.**

The Agreement has no exit clause. Section 10.1 assumes "any agreed transition period" without obliging Vendor to provide one; Section 10.2 covers only Deliverables and refunds. There is no data return, export, or deletion obligation anywhere — Section 15 governs processing only, and Section 16.5 carves Customer Data out of the return-or-destroy duty by deferring to "Sections 11 and 15," yet **Section 11 does not exist in the document** (the outline runs 10.2 → 12). So the carve-out points nowhere, leaving us with no contractual right to get our data back.

That fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export), so I inserted a new Section 10.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter — with a backups/legal-retention carve-out for consistency with Section 16.5. The comment offers 90 days as a fallback. Redline validated (ok:true) against the seed-transition precedent.
